seo.title: Titanium Dioxide TDS, SDS & COA: What to Request | TiO2 Malaysia
seo.meta_description: Understand the difference between titanium dioxide TDS, SDS and COA, add the relevant product or batch context, and request the documents needed for review.

modules.h1: Titanium Dioxide TDS, SDS & COA: What to Request
modules.body: Choose the document types and product context your team needs for technical, safety or batch-quality review, then submit them in one request.

modules.heading: What is the difference between a TDS, SDS and COA?
modules.body: A TDS supports Grade-level technical evaluation, an SDS provides safety and handling information for the relevant product, jurisdiction and language context, and a COA reports results for a specific lot or batch. Select one or more document types and add the product, Grade, revision, language, lot, batch or order details relevant to your review.

modules.heading: Choose the Documents That Match Your Review
modules.intro: Start with the decision your team needs to make. You can choose one document type or combine several in the same request.

choices.heading: Technical evaluation
choices.body: Choose a TDS and add the relevant product Grade. Include a specific revision only if your review requires one.

choices.heading: Safety and handling
choices.body: Choose an SDS and add the relevant product, market or jurisdiction, and language. Include a specific revision if required.

choices.heading: Batch quality review
choices.body: Choose a COA and add any available lot, batch or order reference.

choices.heading: Multiple document needs
choices.body: Select one or more document types and include the relevant product or transaction context in one request.

modules.heading: Add Product Grade Details to Your Request
modules.intro: Select the primary Grade for this request. Selecting a Grade adds product context to your request; it does not indicate document availability.
modules.helper: You can change or remove the selected Grade on the request form. If you also need documents for other Grades, note those Grade names in the additional context field for review.
modules.supplementary_note: Additional Grades can be included as supporting context for review.

modules.heading: Compare TDS, SDS and COA
modules.intro: Each document supports a different review. Use the comparison below to choose the relevant type and prepare useful context.
rows: When reviewing safety and handling information for the relevant product and market context
When reviewing results tied to a specific lot, batch or order context
Product; market or jurisdiction; language; revision if relevant
Product or Grade plus an available lot, batch or order reference
modules.note: The details in the final row are useful context, not a requirement to know every item before starting a request.

modules.heading: What to Include in Your Request
modules.intro: Share the details you already know. You do not need every item before starting a request.

items.label: Product Grade
items.body: Select the primary Grade for the request.

items.label: Document type(s)
items.body: Choose TDS, SDS, COA or more than one type.

items.label: Market or jurisdiction
items.body: Add it when relevant to the review.

items.label: Language
items.body: Include the required language when relevant.

items.label: Revision
items.body: Identify it if a specific version is required.

items.label: Lot, batch or order reference
items.body: Add an available reference when the request concerns transaction-specific results.

items.label: Additional requirements or questions
items.body: Share other useful, non-confidential context, including other relevant Grade names.

modules.note: Required fields are shown on the Request Documents form.

modules.heading: How Document Requests Work
modules.intro: Use one request to identify the documents and product context your team needs.

steps.heading: Choose document types
steps.body: Select TDS, SDS, COA or more than one document type.

steps.heading: Add product context
steps.body: Choose the primary Grade and include any useful revision, language, lot, batch or order details you know. Add other relevant Grade names as supplementary context when needed.

steps.heading: Review your request
steps.body: Check the information carried into the request form. You can change or remove prefilled buyer context before submitting.

steps.heading: Submit for review
steps.body: Send the request with your contact and business details. We may contact you if clarification is needed.

modules.microcopy: Document requests are reviewed after submission; submission does not confirm availability or delivery.

items.question: Can I request more than one document type?
items.answer: Yes. Select the TDS, SDS and COA options that match your review. You can check or change the selected document types on the request form before submitting.

items.question: How should I identify more than one relevant product Grade?
items.answer: Choose one primary Grade on the request form. If other Grades are relevant, add their names in the additional context field.

items.question: What information should I include in a document request?
items.answer: Include the product Grade and the document types you need. Add a revision, market or jurisdiction, language, lot, batch or order reference when it is relevant and available. You do not need to know every detail before starting the request.

items.question: Does selecting a Grade mean its documents are available?
items.answer: No. Selecting a Grade identifies the product context for your request. The requested document types and product details are reviewed after submission.

items.question: What happens after I submit a request?
items.answer: The request and the information you provide are reviewed. We may contact you if clarification is needed.
